line: Out in the world: the sea and the shore
giver: The world itself: each quest appears when the player finds its place, item or biome on the coast or at sea. A few point to the Anglers' society or the Arcane order.
feel: Salt, wrecks and drowned things: short stories that reward sailing out (Small Ships help) and diving down. Sunken fortresses wait for later acts.

quests.title: Bones of the Deep
quests.summary: A dragon's skeleton lies on the sea floor, ribs rising like a reef. Dive to its skull and take one of its bones; the Anglers' society swear it was a sea serpent.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, bone blocks, a potion of water breathing

quests.title: The Tribune of Atlantis
quests.summary: A tribune of white stone stands on the deep sea floor beside drowned Atlantean ruins. Light the tribune's four sea lanterns (bring them down) and the ruins' sealed vault opens.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, prismarine, a trident

quests.title: The Conduit Arch
quests.summary: An arch of prismarine stands on the sea floor with an empty socket. Craft a conduit (heart of the sea and nautilus shells) and set it in the arch to light the waters around.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a nautilus shell, prismarine

quests.title: X Marks the Spot
quests.summary: A buried treasure map from a wreck starts it. Follow the map to the X, dig out the chest (vanilla or Moog's) and bring home the heart of the sea.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a heart of the sea, gold

quests.title: Wreck Diver
quests.summary: Finding a shipwreck starts it. Loot the captain's chest from three different wrecks and piece together their last voyage from the logbooks.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a treasure map, emeralds

quests.title: Drowned Halls
quests.summary: Sunken ruins are thick with drowned. Kill drowned around the ruins until one drops the Drowned Priest's Medallion (quest item), and bring it to a cleric.
quests.reward: Attack XP, a trident, a book of Impaling

quests.title: The Typhon
quests.summary: The sea fortress Typhon rises from the ocean, its guns still manned. Board it from a boat, fight up its decks and hold its bridge until the crew breaks.
quests.reward: Defense XP, an enchanted crossbow, a Small Ships cog

quests.title: The Golden Hind
quests.summary: The sunken ship Ceryneian Hind was carrying a golden figurehead of a deer. Search its flooded holds for the three pieces of the figurehead and rebuild it on deck.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, gold blocks, a book of Depth Strider

quests.title: Salvage Rights
quests.summary: Sunken wreckage lies in the shallows. Salvage planks, rope and a sail from it and build your own Small Ships cog.
quests.reward: Crafting XP, a Small Ships cog, Supplementaries rope

quests.title: The Drowned Keeper
quests.summary: An ocean tower's light has gone out and its keeper walks the shallows as a drowned. Put him to rest and relight the lamp at the top.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a lantern, glowstone

quests.title: Last Orders at the Beach Bar
quests.summary: The beach bar's bartender is swamped and his customers are thirsty and impatient. Mix four Beachparty cocktails and serve them before each customer gives up (a timed rush); he tips you the plastic hat that lets him drink on the job twice as fast.
quests.reward: Cooking XP, the Plastic Drinking Hat, coconut cocktails

quests.title: The Ritual Circle
quests.summary: A circle of torches and shells on the beach. Place a seashell on each stone at sunset and play a beach disc on a radio, and the sea gives something back.
quests.reward: Magic XP, a Beachparty music disc, sunglasses

quests.title: The Faithful Hound
quests.summary: A prismarine statue of a dog still waits for its master on the sea floor. Tame a wolf, bring it to the statue and give it the statue's collar.
quests.reward: Taming XP, a Domestication Innovation collar tag

quests.title: The Underwater Garden
quests.summary: A garden of coral and kelp grows inside sunken walls. Collect five kinds of Rainbow Reef coral and sea plants, then plant a reef of your own.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, coral, sea pickles

quests.title: The Drowned Village
quests.summary: A castle, a church and houses lie under the waves where a village once stood. Find the church bell and the castle's crest, and learn the village's name.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a bell, gold

quests.title: Songs of the Beach
quests.summary: Finding the overgrown disc on the beach starts it. Collect all the Beachparty music discs and play them on a radio.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a radio, a palm bar

quests.title: The Coral Reef
quests.summary: Entering a warm ocean for the first time. Catch three reef fish (tropical fish or Rainbow Reef fish) in a bucket.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, a fish bucket

quests.title: The Frozen Sea
quests.summary: Entering a deep frozen ocean. Cross it among the icebergs and polar bears, and fish through a hole in the ice.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, blue ice

quests.title: Island Life
quests.summary: Landing on a tropical island (Biomes O' Plenty tropics or Regions Unexplored). Crack open a coconut and rest in a hammock between palms.
quests.reward: Foraging XP, coconuts, a Comforts hammock

quests.title: The Rocky Reef
quests.summary: Entering Regions Unexplored's rocky reef or hyacinth deeps. Dive among its stones and bring back its glowing plants.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, hyacinth flowers

quests.title: The Dunes
quests.summary: Walking a dune beach for the first time. Collect seashells and sea stars along the tide line.
quests.reward: Fishing XP, Beachparty seashells

quests.title: The Mangrove Maze
quests.summary: Entering a mangrove swamp. Find your way through the roots by boat to the far side without leaving the water.
quests.reward: Agility XP, a mangrove boat, propagules
